questions.question: In WPA3-Personal, which key exchange mechanism replaces the WPA2 Pre-Shared Key (PSK) 4-way handshake to prevent offline dictionary attacks?
options: Simultaneous Authentication of Equals (SAE)
Extensible Authentication Protocol (EAP-TLS)
Temporal Key Integrity Protocol (TKIP)
Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman Ephemeral with Preshared Key (ECDHE-PSK)

questions.question: Which of the following best describes a 'virtual machine escape' attack in a cloud virtualization environment?
options: An attacker spoofs a hypervisor migration protocol to clone a running VM instance to an unauthorized physical server.
An attacker gains root privileges on a guest OS and uses it to sniff virtual switch traffic bound for adjacent VMs.
An attacker executes code within a guest virtual machine that exploits a vulnerability in the hypervisor to execute arbitrary code on the host operating system.
An attacker bypasses virtual firewalls by encapsulating malicious payload data within legitimate HTTP/2 streams.

questions.question: An application receives an XML payload containing `<!DOCTYPE foo [ <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd"> ]>`. Which parser configuration is the most effective primary mitigation against this XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability?
options: Sanitizing the incoming payload using a URL-encoding filter before parsing.
Restricting file system permissions on `/etc/passwd` so the application process cannot read it.
Validating the incoming XML payload against a pre-compiled XML Schema Definition (XSD).
Completely disabling Document Type Definitions (DTDs) or external entity resolution in the XML parser configuration.

questions.question: In a Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) complying with NIST SP 800-207, what is the primary responsiblity of the Policy Enforcement Point (PEP)?
options: It serves as the authoritative identity provider that issues OAuth2 tokens to authenticated users.
It directly enables, monitors, and terminates the connection between a subject and an enterprise resource based on commands from the Policy Administrator.
It evaluates business rules and threat intelligence to generate the final grant-or-deny decision.
It dynamically calculates real-time risk scores for continuous user evaluation using machine learning models.

questions.question: How does the WebAuthn standard (a core component of FIDO2) inherently provide protection against credential phishing attacks during user authentication?
options: By encrypting the user's master password using a client-side public key before transmitting it over TLS.
By embedding a time-based dynamic OTP algorithm directly into the browser's network stack.
By cryptographically binding the generated assertion signature to the verified origin (domain name) of the relying party.
By enforcing a mandatory biometric scan that cannot be converted to digital tokens or relayed over intermediaries.
